annotations.text:
A — BOLD EDITORIAL

Sells a point of view. Serif display on warm paper, one hot accent, the headline doing the work.

Tradeoff: it promises taste, so the writing and the case studies have to carry it. Weakest if your buyers want proof before personality.

B — DARK TECHNICAL

Sells measurement. Dark ground, mono labels, numbers and a live dashboard above the fold.

Tradeoff: reads B2B and performance-led; can feel cold to owner-run local clients. Needs real metrics to replace the placeholders.

C — WARM & HUMAN

Sells approachability. Cream, rounded arches, plain speech, a free chat instead of a pitch.

Tradeoff: the safest and the most common. Without your own photography and voice it looks like every other small-agency site.
